evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep skips straight into probing: 'Yeah, definitely. What date were you looking to move?' — no time-boxed framing or promise of a dependable quote, no wait for customer buy-in.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into logistics probing without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer during the call.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer during the call.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (model home/office, one-story): ✓ Floor/stories (floor 47, destination is one-story): ✓ Number of rooms (one bedroom, confirmed): ✓ Walking distance (quarter hallway): ✓ Additional items (couch, chairs, bed, table, TV, ~15–20 boxes, bed stands, side tables): ✓ Special considerations (TV on wall, mattress, loose items): ✓ Additional stops (single move, no additional stops probed but not needed): ✓
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Yes: 'Did you need any like packing help or anything like that?' Customer declined.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes: 'And probably what 201520 boxes.' Customer confirmed ~15–20 boxes.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full anchor provided: '$208 per hour for two-man crew, $150 trip fee, 2.5-hour minimum, estimated 4.5–5.5 hours total, range $1,086–$1,294.' Personalized to drive time (1–1.5 hours), elevator efficiency, loose miscellaneous items adding time.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full framing: '$150 trip fee' disclosed, '$2,000 No Worries damage coverage' disclosed, 'two and a half hour minimum,' 'bill in fifteen minute increments,' 'don't have any taxes and we don't have any credit card fees.' Not a guess framing implied through detail.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Rep moves directly to booking without gauging customer reaction or asking 'Does that feel fair?'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full: 'if we're ever late to a window of arrival we give you we do discount you money back.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full: 'we all up to $2,000 per move just to get piece of mind to our clients to know you know, if anything got damaged, you're fully covered' and 'built into the rate' (No Worries is part of hourly rate, not add-on).
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep delivers both promises but does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar closure question to confirm the customer's concerns were addressed.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Throwaway: 'But any other questions that I could answer for you while we're on the phone?' — this is the empty 'any questions' format that automatically gets a no, not the genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No. Rep never asks 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' In the final questions, the customer raises three follow-up concerns about mattress wrapping, TV mounting, and couch padding—these are fielded well but the catch-all was not proactively asked.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: With out: 'Where you wanting to get something on the calendar.' Phrased as a question with an implicit out (customer could have said no); lacks 'Would you like our help with your move?' clarity. Customer accepts, so the move forward happens, but the framing softens the ask.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: False. No language about rate locking or holding the quote.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Full: Date (Tuesday, October 6th, 8:30–9:00 AM arrival window confirmed), phone (513-266-8861 confirmed), addresses (pickup: 600 Gulu Bay Street, Apt 4707; destination: 324 SPRU Drive, Holland TX 76534, both confirmed), crew size (two movers, one truck, confirmed implicitly), elevator reservation (8:00 AM–12:00 PM, confirmed). Email (LauraLay@gmail.com) captured. Confirmation email promised with pricing details. One minor gap: no explicit notes documented for the crew about customer concerns (mattress, TV mounting, couch wrapping are discussed but no documented handoff about these to the crew).

top_strength: Calvin systematically gathered all core logistics details (property type, floor, room count, walking distance, item specifics, box count) and provided a fully anchored, personalized estimate with transparent fee disclosure and damage-coverage framing.
coaching_note: Section 1 is missing the quid pro quo framing entirely—start every call with 'This will take 10–15 minutes and you can walk away with a quote you can depend on. Does that sound good?' before probing; and ask the customer's biggest concerns upfront in Section 2 before moving into logistics details.
